svg.title: KL against transferability
svg.desc: Left: T_lt against KL when theta sweeps 0 to pi gives a U. Right: for a single pair the sign of T depends on n.
svg.text: Figure 4(a) reproduced: T against KL, θ swept over [0, π]
θ > π/2 (target turned against the source)
One pair (θ = π/4, σ = 0.2): KL = 7.3 for every γ,
yet T changes sign three times as n grows.
